item.title: Pulsar at ESUG 2026 (new Smalltalk IDE)
item.description:
📝 Pulsar comes from a fairly simple idea: programming tools should help programmers understand the system, navigate it, change it, and stay close to the code while doing so. Generative tools can certainly help, but I do not think they make those capabilities less important. If anything, they make them more important.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.lorenzano.eu/pulsar-at-esug-2026/

item.title: The Aaronson Oracle
item.description:
📝 Hagelbarger called his machine SEER, for SEquence Extrapolating Robot. Three yes-or-no facts give eight possible situations, and for each of the eight the machine remembered whether playing the same had been working. The two machines played each other Inevitably, someone wondered which machine was better.
🔗 Read more: https://aaronsonoracle.com/
